entries.zh: 新增 `--single-arm`，通过 SDK `Single` 实例用物理右手柄控制独立单臂。启动不要求左手柄就绪。映射使用 `base` 坐标系；`face-to-face` 不交换控制手柄。默认仍为双臂 ServoP。
entries.en: Add `--single-arm` to control a standalone arm with the physical right controller through an SDK `Single` instance. Startup does not require the left controller. Mapping uses the `base` frame; `face-to-face` does not swap controllers. Dual-arm ServoP remains the default.

entries.zh: 新增 `--single-mapping-yaw`，在单臂模式下绕 base Z 旋转平移和旋转增量，范围为 −180° 至 180°，默认 0°。新增 `--no-gripper`，可跳过单臂或双臂的 DH 夹爪初始化和 Trigger 控制。
entries.en: Add `--single-mapping-yaw` to rotate single-arm translation and rotation increments around base Z, from −180° to 180°, defaulting to 0°. Add `--no-gripper` to skip DH gripper initialization and Trigger control in single- or dual-arm operation.

entries.zh: 单臂新增 `--control-mode fdcc|impedance`，对应 `PicoControlMode::Fdcc` 和 `PicoControlMode::CartesianImpedance`。Grip 松开后请求退出柔顺模式并持位，重新握紧从实测 TCP 对齐。两种模式均禁用摇杆 J6，保留夹爪和方向映射。
entries.en: Add single-arm `--control-mode fdcc|impedance`, corresponding to `PicoControlMode::Fdcc` and `PicoControlMode::CartesianImpedance`. Releasing Grip requests exit from compliance mode to hold; re-engaging anchors to the measured TCP. Both modes disable thumbstick J6 while retaining gripper and direction mapping.

entries.zh: FDCC 使用 `SetFdCartesianAdmittancePoseTarget`，发送上限为 50 Hz。默认平移目标整形为 0.30 m/s、1.2 m/s² 和增益 8/s，速度前馈为 0.5。`--fdcc-target-scale` 可启用额外平移超前，最大增加 30 mm；这些参数约束目标，不代表实测运动上限。
entries.en: FDCC uses `SetFdCartesianAdmittancePoseTarget` at up to 50 Hz. Default translation target shaping uses 0.30 m/s, 1.2 m/s² and gain 8/s, with velocity feedforward of 0.5. `--fdcc-target-scale` optionally adds translation lead capped at 30 mm. These settings constrain targets, not measured motion.

entries.zh: 阻抗模式使用 `SetCartesianImpedanceTarget` 写入平衡位姿，发送上限为 200 Hz。`--impedance-stiffness` 和 `--impedance-damping` 接受 XYZ/RX/RY/RZ 六个数值；目标整形参数与刚度、阻尼分开设置。DDS 写入没有送达确认。
entries.en: Impedance mode writes equilibrium poses through `SetCartesianImpedanceTarget` at up to 200 Hz. `--impedance-stiffness` and `--impedance-damping` accept six XYZ/RX/RY/RZ values. Target shaping is configured separately from stiffness and damping. DDS writes have no delivery acknowledgement.

entries.zh: 柔顺模式在输入新鲜但目标预检超过 200 ms 未更新时，保留模式并冻结最后发送的平衡点；新检查通过后自动续跟。输入或雅可比过期、候选被拒绝时暂停，需新鲜的松 Grip 输入及模式 0 确认后重新离合。状态过期、模式丢失或写入失败会结束会话。
entries.en: When input remains fresh but target approval has not renewed for 200 ms, compliance modes retain their mode and freeze the last sent equilibrium. Tracking resumes after a successful check. Stale input or Jacobian data and rejected candidates pause operation; rearming requires fresh released-Grip input and confirmed mode 0. Stale state, mode loss or write failure ends the session.

entries.zh: 新增非有限输入、无效四元数及发送目标检查。单臂忽略未使用的左手数据。柔顺模式使用实测雅可比减速，不再因候选端点条件数达到 60 而拒绝；仍检查 IK 可达性、关节余量及 FK 一致性。ServoP 保留原候选边界策略。
entries.en: Add checks for nonfinite input, invalid quaternions and outgoing targets. Single-arm operation ignores unused left-hand data. Compliance modes use measured-Jacobian slowdown without rejecting candidate endpoints solely for reaching condition number 60. IK reachability, joint clearance and FK consistency checks remain. ServoP retains its candidate-boundary policy.

entries.zh: 新增输入包龄、检查耗时、目标整形差距及跟随误差诊断。`--help-advanced` 展示调参选项，普通帮助聚焦操作参数。新增选项通过 `PicoTeleopOptions` 提供；参数范围和模式组合在连接前校验。
entries.en: Add diagnostics for input age, check duration, shaping gaps and tracking errors. `--help-advanced` exposes tuning options while regular help focuses on operation. New options are available through `PicoTeleopOptions`; ranges and mode combinations are checked before connection.

entries.zh: 修复通过 `find_package(smrcore_peripherals CONFIG)` 使用共享库时额外要求私有开发依赖的问题。共享库配置不再查找 `Threads` 和 `nlohmann_json`；静态库继续解析这些依赖，导出目标仍为 `smrcore::peripherals`。
entries.en: Fix unnecessary private development dependencies when consuming the shared library through `find_package(smrcore_peripherals CONFIG)`. Shared-library configuration no longer looks up `Threads` or `nlohmann_json`. Static consumers still resolve them, and the exported target remains `smrcore::peripherals`.

entries.zh: 网站、手册及 Release 说明生成器新增按不可变 Git 版本范围读取双语变更片段。已发布记录不受后续编辑影响；未提交内容及 `misc` 片段不发布。保留审核摘要优先级和提交说明回退，并校验语言及分类。网站工作流提供 Markdown 预览制品。
entries.en: The website, manual and Release note generator now reads bilingual fragments from immutable Git version ranges. Later edits do not rewrite published notes; uncommitted content and `misc` fragments are excluded. Reviewed summaries retain precedence, commit-note fallback remains, and languages and categories are validated. The website workflow provides Markdown preview artifacts.

entries.zh: 补充中英文单臂 Pico 操作、柔顺模式、调参及暂停/退出说明。现有 Python 启动器可透传这些参数到 C++ bridge。Pico 遥操仍需显式启用 `--with-sdk ON --with-pico ON` 构建；当前预编译 SDK bridge 工作流仍关闭 Pico，仅构建 SpaceMouse 和六维力接入。
entries.en: Add Chinese and English guidance for single-arm Pico operation, compliance modes, tuning and pause/exit behavior. The existing Python launcher forwards these options to the C++ bridge. Pico teleoperation still requires an explicit `--with-sdk ON --with-pico ON` build. The current prebuilt SDK bridge workflow keeps Pico disabled and builds SpaceMouse and force/torque integration.

uncertainties.zh: 源码包含 FDCC 和阻抗接口调用，但本次只读审查不能确认已发布 SDK 二进制及目标柜端提供这些接口，也不能确认实机跟随、接触或 CST 模式切换效果。文档中的编译及离线验证记录不等于硬件验收。
uncertainties.en: The source calls FDCC and impedance APIs, but this read-only review cannot confirm their availability in released SDK binaries or the target cabinet, or establish hardware tracking, contact or CST transition behavior. Documented compilation and offline checks do not constitute hardware acceptance.
